best_hooks: Slow feet don't lose rallies. Not returning to base does.
Weak arms don't kill your smash. Contacting the shuttle behind your head does.
Being short doesn't lose the net. Lunging with the wrong foot does.
props_needed: court lines top-down with six-corner markers
one_line_case: Best engine fit of the four (footwork is top-down geometry), with WTP proven by Badminton Famly at $60-120/yr; no animated incumbent found, but check TikTok in-app search by hand before calling it GO.
